title: 第30章 做人要活
novel_title: 凡人修仙：从废器房杂役开始
content_zh:
知道这灰怎么卖。

    这话一出口，陈青山后背的汗，又冒了。

    他第一反应是装傻。嘴边那句“什么卖不卖，我就引个火”都到舌尖了。

    可一抬眼，看见方大河那张脸——他把话咽了回去。

    那不是要拿他、要告他的脸。是那种闻见了钱味、嘴角直往上翘、想拉人入伙的脸。

    陈青山心里飞快过了一遍。

    硬装不知道，这老江湖一眼就能看穿，反倒结仇。

    地盘是人家的，灰是从人家炉子里出的，牌也是人家发的。

    真撕破脸，他一个头一天来的新杂役，半点便宜占不到，弄不好连三号炉都保不住。

    可全抖出来，也蠢。鼎的事，提纯的事，一个字都不能漏。

    露三分。

    不多不少，刚好够搭上话。

    “方管事。”陈青山没接“卖”那个字，只苦着脸，把破布摊开一角，“我就是觉得，这炉底渣，比炉口那些灰沉。沉的东西，多半压秤，也多半压着料。倒了，怪可惜。”

    方大河咧嘴一笑，露出一口被烟熏黄的牙。

    “沉。”他点点头，“你小子，倒识货。”

    他往四下里瞄了一眼。扒灰的几个杂役离得远，没人看这头。他一把拽住陈青山的胳膊，往三号炉背后挪了两步，避开了人。

    “我跟你交个底。”方大河声音压得极低，“这火脉洞的灰，宗门只论斤收，不论成色收。你交上去三袋足秤的灰，账，就平了。至于炉底这点结渣——”

    他用沾灰的脚尖，碾了碾地上那撮黑末。

    “册子上没它。倒了，是喂火脉。留着，算你的。”

    陈青山心里咯噔一下。

    他自己摸了一晚上才摸出来的那点门道，原来人家早玩得滚瓜烂熟。

    “不过。”方大河脸忽然一沉，凑得更近了些。

    “有句话，我得先撂这儿。你听好。”

    “炉子里那点真矿粉、亮渣子，红得扎眼的那种，你要是动了一根指头的心思，趁早歇了。”

    他往火井那头努了努嘴，声音里带上了点别的东西。

    “前年，有个跟你一样的愣头青，叫赵二。趁夜里没人，摸了内炉一把赤焰矿粉，想揣出去卖。还没出洞口，就被鲁长老逮住了。”

    “吊。”方大河伸出一根手指，朝上一指，“就吊在那火井边上。火井底下是主火脉，那热气往上熏，整整三天三夜。”

    陈青山喉咙不自觉地动了动。

    “第三天放下来的时候，人还喘气。”方大河咂了咂嘴，“可半边身子的皮，没了，跟那炉底渣一个色。后来废了，被人抬下山，再没回来过。”

    他拍了拍陈青山的肩膀，力道不轻。

    “矿粉是宗门入了册的料，少一钱，账上都有数。那是要命的东西，碰不得。”

    “可炉底废渣、扫地碎灰——”他话锋一转，又笑了，“没人入册，也没人稀罕。聪明人，只在这上头做文章。懂了？”

    账面交足，只动废料。

    跟陈青山自己琢磨出来的那条线，一字不差。
content_en:
I know how to sell this ash.

    As soon as these words were spoken, sweat broke out on Chen Qingshan's back again.

    His first reaction was to play dumb. The phrase "I'll cause a fire no matter what is for sale or not" is on the tip of your tongue.

    But when he looked up and saw Fang Dahe's face - he swallowed his words.

    That's not to take advantage of him or sue him. It's the kind of face that turns up the corners of its mouth when it smells money, and wants to attract people to join its gang.

    Chen Qingshan thought about it quickly.

    Pretending not to know, this old Jianghu can see through it at a glance, and turns into a grudge.

    The land belongs to others, the ashes come from their furnaces, and the cards are dealt to them.

    It's really embarrassing. He is a new handyman who came in the first day. He can't take advantage of it at all. He might not even be able to save the No. 3 furnace.

    But it would be stupid to reveal everything. Regarding the tripod and purification, not a single word should be left out.

    Expose three points.

    No more, no less, just enough to strike up a conversation.

    "Manager Fang." Chen Qingshan did not accept the word "sell", but grimaced and spread out a corner of the rag, "I just feel that the slag at the bottom of the furnace is heavier than the ash at the mouth of the furnace. Most of the heavy things weighed down the scales, and most of them weighed down the materials. It's a pity that it fell."

    Fang Dahe grinned, revealing teeth yellowed by smoke.

    "Shen." He nodded, "You know your stuff, kid."

    He glanced around. The handymen who were removing the ashes were far away, and no one was looking at this end. He grabbed Chen Qingshan's arm and moved two steps behind No. 3 furnace to avoid people.

    "Let me explain to you." Fang Dahe's voice was very low, "The sect will only collect the ashes from the Fire Vein Cave according to the pound, regardless of the quality. You hand over three bags of fully weighed ashes, and the account will be settled. As for the slag at the bottom of the furnace -"

    He used his dusty toes to crush the black dust on the ground.

    "It's not in the booklet. If it's poured out, it's for feeding the fire veins. Keep it, it's yours."

    Chen Qingshan's heart skipped a beat.

    It took him a whole night to figure out the little secrets on his own, but it turned out that he was already very familiar with it.

    "But." Fang Dahe's face suddenly sank and he got closer.

    "There is a saying, I have to leave it here first. You listen carefully."

    "That bit of real mineral powder and bright slag in the stove, the kind that's so red that it's eye-catching, if you have even a finger on your mind, take a break as soon as possible."

    He pursed his lips toward the fire well, and there was something else in his voice.

    "The year before last, there was a stupid young man like you named Zhao Er. When no one was around at night, he touched a handful of red flame ore powder in the inner furnace and wanted to sell it. Before he could get out of the cave, he was caught by Elder Lu."

    "Hang." Fang Dahe stretched out a finger and pointed upward, "Hang on the edge of the fire well. Under the fire well is the main fire vein, and the hot air smokes upward for three days and three nights."

    Chen Qingshan's throat moved unconsciously.

    "When I put it down on the third day, I was still panting." Fang Dahe smacked his lips, "But the skin on half of his body was gone, and he was the same color as the slag at the bottom of the furnace. Later, he was disabled and was carried down the mountain and never came back."

    He patted Chen Qingshan's shoulder with considerable force.

    "The mineral powder is the stuff that the sect has recorded. If it's missing a penny, it's all in the account. It's a fatal thing and cannot be touched."

    "But the waste at the bottom of the furnace and the dust on the floor -" he changed the subject and smiled again, "No one is included in the list, and no one cares about it. Smart people only make fuss about this. Understand?"

    The accounts are fully paid and only scraps are used.

    It is exactly the same as the line that Chen Qingshan figured out by himself.
